title: Annotated CT of Adhesive Small Bowel Obstruction with Caliber Change
author: Hellerhoff
caption: Annotated axial and coronal contrast-enhanced CT demonstrating adhesive small bowel obstruction with transition point and collapsed distal bowel.
alt_text: Annotated axial and coronal CT scans showing dilated proximal bowel, transition zone, and decompressed distal bowel.
clinical_relevance: Demonstrates transition-zone pathophysiology and strangulation/ischemia risk in worst-case SBO (CLIFF-037, p.3-6).
